# Template: icon_array
An icon array (pictograph) for absolute-risk communication: a grid of person pictograms — typically 100, "out of 100 people" — colored group by group (e.g. "8 in 100 have a heart attack anyway, 2 avoid one thanks to treatment") with a legend naming each group and its count. The canonical honest way to show absolute risks, risk differences, treatment benefit and harm, and number needed to treat. Choose this scene for ANY request about absolute vs relative risk, "X in 100" or "X per 100" framings, icon arrays, pictographs of people affected, treatment benefit/harm counts, screening benefit, or number needed to treat.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "total": {
   "type": "integer",
   "description": "How many person icons in the grid, 10-100 (default 100)."
  },
  "groups": {
   "type": "array",
   "maxItems": 4,
   "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
     "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Short legend label, e.g. \"Helped\" — keep under ~22 characters."
     },
     "count": {
      "type": "integer"
     },
     "color": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
       "demand",
       "supply",
       "accent",
       "shifted",
       "region2"
      ],
      "description": "Optional; defaults cycle demand (red), supply (blue), accent, shifted."
     }
    },
    "required": [
     "label",
     "count"
    ]
   },
   "description": "Colored subgroups, filled into the grid in order from the top-left; the remainder is drawn neutral grey."
  },
  "rest_label": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Legend label for the uncolored remainder (default \"Unaffected\")."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- group_<i>: the person icons of groups[i] (one group, drawn together)
- rest: the remaining neutral person icons (a group)
- legend_<i>: legend entry (mini icon + count + label) for groups[i]
- legend_rest: legend entry for the remainder
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Show an icon array: 5 in 100 people get the side effect." → params: {"groups":[{"label":"Side effect","count":5}],"rest_label":"No side effect","title":"5 in 100 experience the side effect"}
Request: "Icon array of statin benefit: 8 in 100 have a heart attack anyway, 2 in 100 avoid one." → params: {"groups":[{"label":"Heart attack anyway","count":8,"color":"demand"},{"label":"Avoided (helped)","count":2,"color":"supply"}],"rest_label":"No event either way","title":"What statins change for 100 people"}

In YAML: `template: icon_array` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
